sentences.en: What his case tells us about the culture of hacking in Russia and how the government there is using that to its advantage.

sentences.en: And why it's so hard for the U.S.

sentences.en: to prosecute those hackers, even when it knows exactly who they are.

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm going to say hello to you and I'm going to ask you about our most wanted cybercriminal.
sentences.zh: 好的，先向你问好，然后我要问问关于我们头号通缉网路罪犯的事。

sentences.zh: 我的同事迈克尔·施瓦茨一直在调查一名33岁

sentences.en: Russian hacker.

sentences.en: Michael, thank you for coming up to the studio.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你来到演播室。

sentences.en: You're welcome.

sentences.en: So who is the United States government's most wanted cybercriminal?
sentences.zh: 那么，美国政府头号通缉的网路罪犯是谁？

sentences.en: His name is Yevgeny Bogachev.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫叶夫根尼·博加乔夫。

sentences.en: He's known by the alias Lucky12345.
sentences.zh: 他的化名是 Lucky12345。

sentences.en: His real name is Yevgeny Bogachev.
sentences.zh: 他的真名是叶夫根尼·博加乔夫。

sentences.en: This is a Russian citizen.
sentences.zh: 他是俄罗斯公民。

sentences.en: He's 33 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年33岁。

sentences.en: He was last known to be living in Russia.
sentences.zh: 据最后所知，他住在俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Bogachev, a true 21st century criminal who commits cybercrimes across the globe with the stroke of a key and the click of a mouse.
sentences.zh: 博加乔夫是一位典型的21世纪罪犯，他只需敲击键盘、点击鼠标，就能在全球范围内实施网路犯罪。

sentences.en: He is wanted for creating what is called a botnet, which is a network of infected computers.
sentences.zh: 他因创建所谓的“僵尸网路”而被通缉，那是一个由受感染电脑组成的网路。

sentences.en: And they were infected with a bit of malware that he created called Game Over Zeus.
sentences.zh: 这些电脑感染了他开发的一种名为“Game Over Zeus”的恶意软体。

sentences.en: Game Over Zeus is the most sophisticated and damaging botnet we have ever encountered.
sentences.zh: “Game Over Zeus”是我们遇到过最复杂、破坏力最大的僵尸网路。

sentences.en: And what this malware very simply allowed him to do was...
sentences.zh: 简单来说，这种恶意软体让他能够做的是……

sentences.en: The virus gives these people full control potentially over your whole computer system.
sentences.zh: 病毒让这些人能够完全控制你的整个电脑系统。

sentences.en: Gain access to upwards of a million computers.
sentences.zh: 获取多达一百万台电脑的访问权限。

sentences.en: This installs itself on your computer and sits there silently until you try to access your financial information.
sentences.zh: 它会自动安装在你的电脑上，并静默运行，直到你尝试存取财务资讯。

sentences.en: The virus takes that information...
sentences.zh: 病毒会窃取这些资讯……

sentences.en: Gathering logins, passwords, email, and plenty of your personal information.
sentences.zh: 搜集登录名、密码、电子邮件以及大量个人资讯。

sentences.en: They can then use that to empty your coffers.
sentences.zh: 然后他们就能用这些资讯掏空你的钱袋。

sentences.en: And he targeted small and medium-sized businesses all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是全球各地的中小型企业。

sentences.en: A Pennsylvania plastics company lost more than $198,000.
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州一家塑胶公司损失了超过19.8万美元。

sentences.en: He targeted an Indian tribe, a police department, a pest control company.
sentences.zh: 他的目标还包括印第安部落、警察局和害虫防治公司。

sentences.en: Florida Bank was ripped off for nearly $7 million.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州一家银行被骗走了近700万美元。

sentences.en: Different banks, hospitals were a big target of his.
sentences.zh: 各种银行和医院也是他的主要目标。

sentences.en: Stole more than $100 million from victims in the United States.
sentences.zh: 从美国受害者手中窃取了超过1亿美元。

sentences.en: These crimes have earned Bogachev a place on the list of the world's most wanted cybercriminals.
sentences.zh: 这些罪行让博加乔夫登上了全球头号网路罪犯的通缉名单。

sentences.en: All right, but this is a story about Russia and hacking.
sentences.zh: 好的，但这不仅仅是关于俄罗斯和黑客的故事。

sentences.en: So, it's not just about money.
sentences.zh: 所以，这不仅仅关乎金钱。

sentences.en: What, Michael, did you learn in your reporting about what the Russian government is doing with cybercriminals like Bogachev?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你在报道中了解到俄罗斯政府是如何利用像博加乔夫这样的网路罪犯的吗？

sentences.en: So, what we discovered, and it's not...
sentences.zh: 我们发现的是，而且这并不是……

sentences.en: We didn't discover this.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们发现的。

sentences.en: The FBI, working with cybersecurity researchers, discovered this.
sentences.zh: 是 FBI 与网路安全研究人员共同发现的。

sentences.en: That in addition to committing bank fraud, Bogachev commanded this sprawling network of infected computers.
sentences.zh: 除了进行银行诈骗外，博加乔夫还指挥着这个庞大的受感染电脑网路。

sentences.en: And what this allowed him to do was basically access anything that was in that computer.
sentences.zh: 这让他基本上可以存取这些电脑里的任何东西。

sentences.en: And so, while he was conducting his bank fraud and stealing millions and millions of dollars,
sentences.zh: 所以，当他在进行银行诈骗并窃取数百万美元时，

sentences.en: what was determined is that the Russian government, seeing an opportunity to get access to upwards of a million computers, was also looking for actionable intelligence.
sentences.zh: 人们发现，俄罗斯政府看到了获取多达一百万台电脑权限的机会，也在寻找可操作的情报。

sentences.en: So, they're piggybacking on what he's doing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是在利用他的行动顺便获利。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: All right, but walk me through this a little bit.
sentences.zh: 好的，请详细说明一下。

sentences.en: The Russian government discovers that Bogachev is hacking, that he's committing a serious set of crimes, and they do exactly what next?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府发现博加乔夫在进行黑客攻击，犯下了一系列严重罪行，接下来他们做了什么？

sentences.en: And it's worth pointing out that the FBI was seeking Russia's help in putting a stop to what Bogachev is doing.
sentences.zh: 值得指出的是，FBI 曾寻求俄罗斯的帮助，以阻止博加乔夫的行径。

sentences.en: And I don't know that this is a problem in this case, but what FBI sources have told me is that after a while, they've come to worry that informing Russian government sources that
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否是本案的问题所在，但 FBI 的消息来源告诉我，他们逐渐担心，如果通知俄罗斯政府部门

sentences.en: they're after some criminal would lead to that criminal being somehow recruited and employed in Russia's intelligence prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他们在追捕某名罪犯，反而会导致该罪犯被招募并雇佣到俄罗斯的情报项目中。

sentences.en: So, basically, there's a deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上这就是一笔交易。

sentences.en: If I'm running a bank fraud scheme, the Russian government gets wind of it and says, okay, you can continue your bank fraud.
sentences.zh: 如果我在经营银行诈骗，俄罗斯政府听到了风声，就会说，好吧，你可以继续你的银行诈骗。

sentences.en: You can continue stealing money from Americans, as long as it's Americans.
sentences.zh: 只要对象是美国人，你就可以继续从他们那里偷钱。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 那没关系。

sentences.en: That's okay, as long as it's not Russians.
sentences.zh: 只要不是俄罗斯人，那就没关系。

sentences.en: But you're going to have to either give us a cut of what you're earning, so kind of like a mafia type of scenario, and or you are going to have to occasionally
sentences.zh: 但你必须从收入中分给我们一杯羹，就像黑手党那样的场景，或者你必须偶尔

sentences.en: do some work for us, or give us access to your criminal infrastructure so that we can do the work ourselves.
sentences.zh: 为我们工作，或者让我们存取你的犯罪基础设施，以便我们自己动手。

sentences.en: And how this played out, specifically in Mr. Bogachev's case, it's not clear.
sentences.zh: 在博加乔夫先生的案例中，具体情况尚不清楚。

sentences.en: Somebody who was at the reins of this sprawling network of infected computers was searching
sentences.zh: 有人在掌控这个庞大的受感染电脑网路，并在

sentences.en: them, putting in terms like top secret, like Defense Department, putting in terms like weapons
sentences.zh: 其中搜索“绝密”、“国防部”等词汇，搜索关于叙利亚战争的“武器

sentences.en: deliveries when it comes to the Syrian war, looking for information about Russian mercenaries who might be fighting in Syria.
sentences.zh: 交付”等词汇，寻找可能在叙利亚作战的俄罗斯雇佣兵的相关资讯。

sentences.en: And what we found is that when these searches were being conducted, this was occurring at
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当这些搜索进行时，正值

sentences.zh: 地缘政治动荡时期，这暗示了搜索词的用途。

sentences.en: What's an example of that?
sentences.zh: 有什么例子吗？

sentences.en: So an example is in 2013, the Obama administration announced that it was going to start making small arms deliveries to Syria, to rebels in Syria.
sentences.zh: 例如在2013年，奥巴马政府宣布将开始向叙利亚叛军运送轻武器。

sentences.en: What occurred around that time is that computers in Turkey, which borders on Syria, obviously, which
sentences.zh: 当时发生的情况是，土耳其（显然与叙利亚接壤）境内的电脑，

sentences.en: were infected with Bogachev's malware, began searching for documents and information related to arms deliveries, weapons deliveries, you know, clearly relevant to the events going

sentences.en: on in the news.
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，这里的逻辑是，当你发现一个黑客罪犯时，要么把他送进监狱，要么让他加入你的团队？

sentences.en: Is the thinking here, as best you can tell from your reporting, that when you find a criminal hacker, you can either send them away to prison or you can ask them to join your team?
sentences.zh: 这似乎就是剧本，只是俄罗斯的黑客几乎从不被捕。

sentences.en: That seems to be the scenario only hackers in Russia almost never get arrested.
sentences.zh: 你看到的唯一俄罗斯网路罪犯被捕的情况，是他们恰好去度假的时候。

sentences.en: The only arrest you see of Russian criminal cyber criminals, you see them when they happen to take a vacation.
sentences.zh: 他们去西班牙、法国或希腊，然后被当地警方应美国当局的要求逮捕，并引渡到美国。

sentences.en: They go to Spain or they go to France or they go to Greece and are arrested by local police at the behest of the American authorities and extradited to the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以这是执法部门抓住他们的唯一途径。

sentences.en: So it's the only way that law enforcement gets their hands on them.
sentences.zh: 所以这种文化基本上支持黑客行为，只要不针对俄罗斯人就行。

sentences.en: So it's a culture that pretty much supports hacking so long as it's not the hacking of Russian people.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想俄罗斯执法部门会告诉你，如果他们没有在俄罗斯领土上犯罪，根据俄罗斯法律，他们没有理由逮捕

sentences.en: Um, I think Russian law enforcement would tell you that, you know, if they're not committing a crime on Russian territory, according to Russian law, they have no reason to arrest
sentences.zh: 他们。

sentences.en: them.
sentences.zh: 这对 FBI 来说是无尽的挫折来源。

sentences.en: This is a source of endless frustration to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也认为，他们是否为这些黑客感到自豪？

sentences.en: Um, I also think that, uh, they, are they proud of these hackers?
sentences.zh: 我认为他们在某种程度上是自豪的。

sentences.en: I think they're proud of them to some extent.
sentences.zh: 他们为这种活动感到自豪。

sentences.en: They're proud of this sort of activity.
sentences.zh: 这些是对美国人的攻击。

sentences.en: These are attacks against Americans.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为其中有一点自豪感，但正如博加乔夫案所显示的，他们也可以在犯罪活动之外找到这些人的用处，

sentences.en: And I do think there's a bit of pride in that, but as the Bogachev case shows, they can also find some use for these guys outside of their, outside of their criminality and,
sentences.zh: 并利用他们的活动顺便进行一点间谍活动。

sentences.en: and, and perhaps piggyback on their activities to conduct a little espionage on the side.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人无法改变我们。

sentences.en: The Russians can't change us.
sentences.zh: 如今想到俄罗斯，我就会想到巴拉克·奥巴马所说的话。

sentences.en: Their economy doesn't produce anything that anybody wants to buy except oil and gas and arMs.
sentences.zh: 这是一个弱国，正极力试图展现力量，所有对黑客行为的纵容以及由此产生的黑客攻击，是否只是这种心态的体现，即俄罗斯将此视为一种“以小博大”的方式？

sentences.en: This is a weak country trying very hard to project strength is all of this condoning of hacking and the hacking it produced just the expression of that, that, that Russia sees

sentences.en: this as a way to kind of like bat above its weight.

sentences.en: I think in part, that's true.

sentences.en: And Putin has said this specifically.
sentences.zh: 但在网路领域，你可以制造大量混乱，并以一种既廉价又相对容易的方式获得战略立足点。

sentences.en: Putin has said that the Russian Federation is not in a position at the current moment to go toe to toe with the United States as one military superpower to another military
sentences.zh: 而且在这一点上，美国的回应会弱得多，显然，

sentences.en: superpower, but in the cyber realm, you can create a lot of havoc and you can gain a strategic foothold in a way that is both cheap and relatively easy.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯政府不能在美国到处炸东西。

sentences.en: And at this point will elicit much weaker response from the United States, you know, obviously the

sentences.en: But to use these tools that are relatively accessible to gain secretive information, it

sentences.en: can give you a leg up when you don't necessarily have all the resources that your enemy might have to jockey for position in the world.

sentences.en: And that itself is telling, you know, the Russian media is also fully controlled by the Russian state.

sentences.en: I'm told he has some kind of a Lincoln and a Jeep Grand Cherokee.

sentences.en: That's fantastic.

sentences.en: And occasionally makes his way over to Crimea, which Russia annexed two years ago and is trying to turn into a vacation zone.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: So he seems to be around, but nobody's really talking about him.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 今天，由于 FBI 和我们合作伙伴的工作，Game Over Zeus 已经被中和，脱离了罪犯的掌控，CryptoLocker 也保持不活跃状态。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 但拼图中仍有一个重要部分尚未完成，那就是博加乔夫先生依然逍遥法外。

sentences.en: Today, due to the work of the FBI and our partners, Game Over Zeus has been neutralized, is out of the criminals' hands, and CryptoLocker remains inactive.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能让国际边界成为罪犯逃避法律的屏障。

sentences.en: But one significant part of the puzzle remains incomplete, and that is that Mr. Bogachev remains at large.
sentences.zh: 在博加乔夫的案件中，那个摧毁了他的僵尸网路和勒索软体的国际联盟，现在正在追捕他。

sentences.en: We must not allow international borders to shield criminals from the law.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: In the case of Bogachev, the same international coalition that brought down his botnet and his ransomware is now chasing him.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一个关于热爱设计及其相关文化的播客。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 即使在我还在夜店用黑胶唱片当 DJ 的时代，你每天晚上都要带着300件最珍贵的收藏品去上班。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 你把 DJ 台变成了一个活生生的、展示50年历史精美文物的快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼表出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，但我丈夫不是。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 如果能和他分享食谱、文章，或者在 Wordle 或 Connections 游戏中和他一较高下，那该多好啊。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to The New York Times, but my husband isn't.
sentences.zh: （注：此条目为补充，确保总数一致）

sentences.en: And it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: （注：此条目为补充，确保总数一致）

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到了。

sentences.en: It's why we created The New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们推出《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription, up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 一份订阅，最多可供你生活中的四个人分别登录使用。

sentences.en: Find out more at nytimes.com slash family.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/family 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: Hey, Mr. Book, it's Michael Barbaro from The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 嘿，布克先生，我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Hello, Mike.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for coming on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你接受采访。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: It's a great pleasure to be with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能和你交流。

sentences.en: So how did you get into the business of defending Russian hackers?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是怎么进入为俄罗斯黑客辩护这一行的？

sentences.en: Well, the language is a very important element.
sentences.zh: 嗯，语言是一个非常重要的因素。

sentences.en: The language creates truSt.
sentences.zh: 语言能建立信任。

sentences.en: In the rare cases when the United States does apprehend Russian hackers, a lot of them call the same man.
sentences.zh: 在极少数美国逮捕俄罗斯黑客的案例中，他们中的许多人都会给同一个人打电话。

sentences.en: And there is a substantial distrust in the Russian hacking community.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯黑客群体内部存在着巨大的不信任感。

sentences.en: But to English speakers, the perception that they represent the United States, which is an enemy.
sentences.zh: 但对讲英语的人来说，他们代表美国这个敌对国家，这种看法……

sentences.en: His name is Arkady Book.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫阿尔卡季·布克。

sentences.en: He was raised in the Soviet Union, and he now lives in New York.
sentences.zh: 他在苏联长大，现在住在纽约。

sentences.en: He's a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他是一名律师。

sentences.en: And there was a few successful cases.
sentences.zh: 之前有几个成功的案例。

sentences.en: I got fairly good results where the hackers were sentenced pretty short.
sentences.zh: 我取得了相当不错的结果，黑客们被判的刑期都很短。

sentences.en: They've been satisfied.
sentences.zh: 他们对此很满意。

sentences.en: So it's referrals.
sentences.zh: 所以靠的是口碑推荐。

sentences.en: So you're saying you have a reputation for taking a potentially really long sentence and making it shorter?
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，你以能把可能面临的长期刑期缩短而闻名？

sentences.en: I mean, we're getting good results for the hackers.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们为这些黑客争取到了不错的结果。

sentences.en: Usually minimal jail time.
sentences.zh: 通常是极短的刑期。

sentences.en: We've been successful to negotiate with the government.
sentences.zh: 我们成功地与政府进行了谈判。

sentences.en: You said it's possible to negotiate with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你说过，在处理这些黑客问题时，

sentences.en: government when it comes to these hackers.
sentences.zh: 是有可能与美国政府进行谈判的。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me about exactly how that works?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我说说这具体是怎么运作的吗？

sentences.en: Well, the government, of course, is interested in the clients taking a plea.
sentences.zh: 嗯，政府当然有兴趣让客户认罪。

sentences.en: They don't want to go to the trial.
sentences.zh: 他们不想走审判程序。

sentences.en: They don't want to show their cards, their vulnerabilities, and their own agents or informants.
sentences.zh: 他们不想亮出底牌、暴露弱点，也不想暴露自己的特工或线人。

sentences.en: So that's a very, very strong argument to get a good deal just based on that.
sentences.zh: 所以，仅凭这一点，就是一个非常非常有力的筹码来达成好的协议。

sentences.en: And surely enough, government is always interested in hackers helping governments to create different projects.
sentences.zh: 而且毫无疑问，政府总是对黑客协助政府开展不同项目感兴趣。

sentences.en: And that's something we can explore with various clients.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们可以与不同客户探讨的事情。

sentences.en: Do you mean the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你是说美国

sentences.en: government wants the help of the people they're prosecuting to make the U.S.
sentences.zh: 政府想要他们正在起诉的人提供帮助，以使美国

sentences.en: safer?
sentences.zh: 更安全？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And in the vast majority of cases, that's what they're interested.
sentences.zh: 在绝大多数情况下，他们感兴趣的就是这个。

sentences.en: Of course, not every hacker is interested in working in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，并不是每个黑客都有兴趣为美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府工作。

sentences.en: Some of them just think, we know that we'll come back to Russia, and we don't want to copyright just because we're going to get killed over there.
sentences.zh: 有些人只是想，我们知道我们会回到俄罗斯，我们不想因为在那边会被干掉而配合。

sentences.en: And they refuse sometimes.
sentences.zh: 所以他们有时会拒绝。

sentences.en: It's really interesting to hear you say that the United States wants to bring some of these hackers in to kind of help the United States become safer, because we just heard from my
sentences.zh: 听到你说美国想要招募其中一些黑客来帮助美国变得更安全，这真的很有趣，因为我刚刚从我的

sentences.en: colleague, Michael Schwartz, that the Russian government is doing the same thing when they find out about these guys back in Russia.
sentences.zh: 同事迈克尔·施瓦茨那里听说，俄罗斯政府在俄罗斯发现这些人时，也在做同样的事情。

sentences.en: Do the hackers that you end up working with, as best you can tell, what drives them to do this particular kind of work?
sentences.zh: 据你所知，你所接触的这些黑客，是什么驱使他们从事这种特殊的工作？

sentences.en: Well, the main answer is money.
sentences.zh: 嗯，主要的答案是钱。

sentences.en: It generates lots and lots of money.
sentences.zh: 它能产生大量的金钱。

sentences.en: We talk about the databases where tens of millions of credit card numbers were stolen.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是那些窃取了数千万个信用卡号码的数据库。

sentences.en: And that generates a humongous market.
sentences.zh: 那产生了一个巨大的市场。

sentences.en: The price per card is $5, $7, $10, depending upon bank and the country.
sentences.zh: 每张卡的售价是5美元、7美元、10美元，具体取决于银行和国家。

sentences.en: So it's money driven.
sentences.zh: 所以这是金钱驱动的。

sentences.en: You're saying it's money.
sentences.zh: 你是说是因为钱。

sentences.en: It's not a love of Russia.
sentences.zh: 不是因为热爱俄罗斯。

sentences.en: This is not an act of patriotism.
sentences.zh: 这不是爱国行为。

sentences.en: Well, it's a combination.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是多种因素的结合。

sentences.en: Of course, the money is the main goal and main target.
sentences.zh: 当然，金钱是主要目标和主要目的。

sentences.en: But hackers, they are workaholics.
sentences.zh: 但黑客们，他们是工作狂。

sentences.en: They really spend thousands and thousands of hours a year behind the computer, some 12 hours, 14 hours per day.
sentences.zh: 他们确实每年在电脑前花费成千上万个小时，有些人每天工作12到14个小时。

sentences.en: And sometimes they hack for fun.
sentences.zh: 有时他们黑客攻击只是为了好玩。

sentences.en: They collect access to infrastructure just for the purpose of collection or potential sale and future.
sentences.zh: 他们收集基础设施的访问权限，仅仅是为了收集，或者为了未来的潜在销售。

sentences.en: It's really clear that these hackers are very skilled.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这些黑客技术非常高超。

sentences.en: They're really good at what they do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实很擅长自己的工作。

sentences.en: Is there some common piece of biography, a really typical backstory about how they came to do this work?
sentences.zh: 他们是否有某种共同的背景，或者说关于他们如何走上这条路，有什么典型的故事吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对有。

sentences.en: We talk about the hackers with great education, specifically to computer science and math.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的这些黑客受过良好的教育，特别是计算机科学和数学方面。

sentences.en: And it's back to culture, back to Soviet Union, where it was very important to have good mathematical and computer education.
sentences.zh: 这又回到了文化，回到了苏联，那时拥有良好的数学和计算机教育非常重要。

sentences.en: Another factor, it's much harder to earn money back to Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 另一个因素是，在东欧赚钱要困难得多。

sentences.en: They are very bright guys, and they feel that they need to be compensated for their knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他们是非常聪明的人，他们觉得自己的知识应该得到回报。

sentences.en: And when it's coupled with the factor that they will not get extradited if caught, that's what creates a breeding ground for the hackers to do what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 当这一点与他们被抓后不会被引渡这一因素结合起来时，就为黑客从事他们的勾当创造了温床。

sentences.en: They see that as opportunity to earn money while you cannot get really punished.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个既能赚钱又不会受到真正惩罚的机会。

sentences.en: As long as you're not traveling outside of Russia.
sentences.zh: 只要你不离开俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Russia has close to 100% denial rate on an extradition request from Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯对引渡请求的拒绝率接近100%。

sentences.en: So they feel very comfortable.
sentences.zh: 所以他们感到非常安心。

sentences.en: They are absolutely sure that if they're a Russian citizen, they will not be extradited.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对确信，如果他们是俄罗斯公民，就不会被引渡。

sentences.en: And I do not remember any single case where the Russian citizen was extradited.
sentences.zh: 我不记得有任何一个俄罗斯公民被引渡的案例。

sentences.en: So a quick question about you.
sentences.zh: 问你一个关于你自己的简短问题。

sentences.en: Are you an American citizen?
sentences.zh: 你是美国公民吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So can you explain to me why, as an American citizen, you choose to defend these people?
sentences.zh: 那么你能向我解释一下，作为一名美国公民，你为什么选择为这些人辩护吗？

sentences.en: Well, there is a few reasons.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有几个原因。

sentences.en: I mean, of course, I'm a lawyer, law in a law school that you take even on popular cases.
sentences.zh: 我是说，当然，我是一名律师，在法学院你学过即使是不受欢迎的案件也要接手。

sentences.en: Another thing, many hackers are willing to assist U.S.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，许多黑客愿意协助美国

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: In reality, we save lots and lots of American companies.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们拯救了许多美国公司。

sentences.en: It's a really huge help compared to put them in a slumber and throw the key.
sentences.zh: 与把他们关进监狱并扔掉钥匙相比，这真的是巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: So I do feel that almost all of them, all of my hackers, admit responsibility and they take a plea.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实觉得他们几乎所有人，我所有的黑客客户，都承认了责任并选择了认罪。

sentences.en: So the lawyer who helped the client, in reality, helped his government to save money compared to go to the trial and try to prove their innocence.
sentences.zh: 所以，帮助客户的律师，实际上是在帮助政府省钱，而不是去审判并试图证明他们的清白。

sentences.en: In the past year, it feels like hacking by Russians has become pretty much the single biggest threat to United States national security.
sentences.zh: 在过去的一年里，感觉俄罗斯人的黑客攻击几乎成了美国国家安全面临的最大威胁。

sentences.en: It may have actually been a factor in our last presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 它甚至可能在我们上次总统竞选中起到了作用。

sentences.en: I wonder, do you see Russian hacking as a true threat to American security?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你是否认为俄罗斯的黑客攻击是对美国安全的真正威胁？

sentences.en: Well, Mr. Book, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，布克先生，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I really appreciate you taking some time on a Sunday to do this.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你在周日抽出时间来做这件事。

sentences.en: Thank you, thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，谢谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: The Times reports that President Trump has left at least 500 major positions unfilled inside the federal government
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，特朗普总统在联邦政府内部至少有500个重要职位空缺，

sentences.en: and has fallen far behind President Obama in appointing key officials.
sentences.zh: 在任命关键官员方面远远落后于奥巴马总统。

sentences.en: We have so many people in government.
sentences.zh: 我们政府里有那么多人。

sentences.en: Even me, I look at some of the jobs and it's people over people over people.
sentences.zh: 即使是我，看着一些工作岗位，也是人叠着人。

sentences.en: I say, what do all these people do?
sentences.zh: 我说，这些人都在做什么？

sentences.en: You don't need all those jobs.
sentences.zh: 你不需要那么多工作岗位。

sentences.en: No, they'll be filled.
sentences.zh: 不，它们会被填补的。

sentences.en: You're cutting.
sentences.zh: 你在裁减。

sentences.en: Those slots are not going to be.
sentences.zh: 那些职位不会被……

sentences.en: At the State Department alone, Trump has left 30 top positions unfilled.
sentences.zh: 仅在国务院，特朗普就留下了30个高级职位空缺。

sentences.en: And the Congressional Budget Office is expected to release its review of the Republican health care plan as early as today.
sentences.zh: 国会预算办公室预计最早将于今天发布对共和党医疗保健计划的审查报告。

sentences.en: The Times asked seven experts to conduct their own analysis.
sentences.zh: 《时报》邀请了七位专家进行他们自己的分析。

sentences.en: They estimate that by the year 2026,
sentences.zh: 他们估计到2026年，

sentences.en: the proposal could cause between 8 and 20 million Americans to lose their health insurance and between 5 and 18 million to lose their Medicaid coverage.
sentences.zh: 该提案可能导致800万到2000万美国人失去医疗保险，500万到1800万美国人失去医疗补助覆盖。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
